title: Inviolata integra et casta es (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Inviolata integra et casta es. 12 voices (Discantus 1, Discantus 2, Cantus 1, Cantus 2, Altus 1, Altus 2, Altus 3, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus 1, Bassus 2, Bassus tertius), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2405); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
